<div style="margin:0 5px">Items offer a vast array of different buffs which help with progressing through the game. There are currently 3 tiers of items based on where and how they can be obtained. Certain items can also be obtained from additional sources like opening [[File:Gift.png|x20px]] [[Store#Gifts|Gifts]], using [[Codes#Reward_Codes|Redeem Codes]] or [[Events#List_of_rewards|Event rewards]].</div></div>

==Item Effects==
<tabber class="sticky-header">

==Items from Gifts==
{{See also|Store#Gifts}}
Certain items can also be obtained from opening [[File:Gift.png|x20px]] [[Store#Gifts|Gifts]]. Quality and type of those items depends on game progression. These items are:
* [[File:Buttery Lobster.png|x20px]] Buttery Lobster
* [[File:Frogspawn.png|x20px]] Frogspawn
* [[File:Forbidden Sushi.png|x20px]] Forbidden Sushi
* [[File:Gold Flake Steak.png|x20px]] Gold Flake Steak
* [[File:Cosmic Candy.png|x20px]] Cosmic Candy
* [[File:Blue Cow.png|x20px]] Blue Cow (replaced by Tier 2 Items after unlocking Fishing)
* [[File:Primal Meat.png|x20px]] Primal Meat (replaced by Sushi after unlocking Fishing)
* [[File:Chaos Totem.png|x20px]] Chaos Totem
* [[File:Charge Magnet.png|x20px]] Charge Magnet (replaced by 5x Fishing Tick Chance +25% after unlocking Fishing)
* [[File:Sushi.png|x20px]] Sushi (requires Obelisk 37+)
* [[File:Skill Bit.png|x20px]] Skill Bits

==Items from Redeem Codes==
{{See also|Codes#Reward_Codes}}
Few items can also be obtained by typing in [[Codes]]. Currently these items are:
* [[File:Blue Cow.png|x20px]] Blue Cow
* [[File:Charge Magnet.png|x20px]] Charge Magnet
* [[File:Time-Turner.png|x20px]] Time-Turner
* [[File:Sushi.png|x20px]] Sushi (requires Obelisk 37+)
